chapter: Blackbirds, Carmen Jones and the Ziegfeld Follies
title: Entertaining the Duke and Duchess at Ascot
summary: Corrected to 1936, he describes being driven in a Rolls Royce to entertain royalty at a fireside, finding it too nonchalant, and declining a party invitation.

story.theme_name: Going abroad: American jazz musicians touring and living in Europe
story.community_name: Going abroad: touring Europe and Japan

blocks.x: This was your first time on television?

Yeah, this was the first time we was on television -- no this was the first broadcast television -- I think it was in 1936, not 1930. '30 we went on the radio -- we did a television broadcast in 1936. You understand? And it was their first broadcast of television, in '36. And we went out with Dudley Coates, Lady Montbatton, to Ascot Park, they took us out there to entertain the Duke and the Duchess and they took us out in a Rolls Royce, they brought us back in a Rolls Royce and they was racing all the way. I said, Oh, if I died, wouldn't that be something? All this royal blood we were mixed up in, you know. I said, what could be sweeter. However, we do the show, do the show entertain them. And it was so cool the way we entertained over ther -- great big

old fireplace in the middle of the room, baby grand on the one end in the room, and the fireplace in the center of the room and you entertained, they sitting by the fire, drinking, and you entertained at the piano, and when you finished a song, they don't know you finished, then they ask you to do another song, you do another song in the same style and they're still getting warm, drinking. It's just like a dead -- I don't know to mention it. It's so nonchalant, I got sick of the idea so I had to leave there. So when they brought us back to England I'm going to come back to America. So Dudley Coates want us to stay over another week longer and they would give a party for us. Mr. Coates, I said, I'm sorry, but I want to know how long it will be, only a fortnight. She said to a friend who was with her, they are only going to be a fortnight. "We want to give a party for you -- so and so and so --" Here's my card in case you change your mind give me a ring." I says, "Okay." Never did ring her. Come on back to America. But you see,
